home.indiaText: CroxX India brings CroxX’s German fertilizer expertise to Indian agriculture, working closely with our partners and farmers to address local crop needs and growing conditions. Our portfolio includes water-soluble and specialty fertilizers, micronutrients, biostimulants, nitrogen stabilizers, nutrient enhancers and controlled-release fertilizers. footprint.certDesc: CroxX's inhibitor solutions contribute actively to climate protection by reducing greenhouse gas emissions after fertilizer application. Their carbon footprint has been calculated and verified according to ISO 14067:2018, the international standard for product-level greenhouse gas accounting.
footprint.whatTitle: What is a Product Carbon Footprint (PCF)?
footprint.whatDesc: A Product Carbon Footprint represents the total greenhouse gas emissions associated with a product, expressed as CO₂ equivalents (CO₂-e). It provides a transparent measure of its climate impact and covers all relevant life cycle stages, from raw material extraction to application in the field.
footprint.howTitle: How we calculate the carbon footprint
footprint.howDesc: Our life-cycle approach considers every significant source of greenhouse gases through the product's life cycle:
footprint.rawDesc: sourcing and production of all components.
footprint.mfgDesc: energy use and emissions from our production facilities.
footprint.transDesc: logistics from ingredient suppliers and intermediate products.
footprint.appDesc: emissions and environmental effects after fertilizer application.
footprint.reduceDesc: Nitrification inhibitors (like DMPP) stabilize nitrogen in the soil, reducing emissions of nitrous oxide (N₂O) - a greenhouse gas 298 times more potent than CO₂ - by up to 50%. Urease inhibitors reduce ammonia volatilization, preventing indirect greenhouse gas formation while maximizing nitrogen use efficiency.
footprint.verifyDesc: The calculation of the CroxX product carbon footprints was conducted independently and verified by authorized certifiers according to ISO 14067:2018.
footprint.reduceDescActual: When conventional fertilizers are applied, nitrogen can be lost as ammonia (NH₃), nitrous oxide (N₂O), or through nitrate (NO₃-) leaching. Our inhibitors slow down nitrogen-transformation processes, reducing losses at all intermediate stages. As a result, reactive nitrogen is transformed efficiently into plant biomass rather than greenhouse gases, achieving a tangible reduction in CO₂-e emissions.
footprint.benefitsTitle: Your benefits from our certified carbon footprint
footprint.emissionReportingDesc: Integrate verified PCF data into your corporate carbon accounting.
footprint.supplyChainDesc: Provide certified emission data to customers and partners to document climate performance along the value chain.
footprint.respCommDesc: Use ISO-verified data to support your sustainability claims.
footprint.uponRequest: Upon request, we provide Product Carbon Footprint Certificates that summarize the key figures and emission reductions achieved with our inhibitors.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Commitment to Data Protection and Privacy under Indian IT Laws
privacy.s1Body: CroxX ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy applies to our website and services, outlining our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of your information in compliance with the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Information Technology (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011, and the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 of India.
privacy.s2Intro: We may collect the following types of information when you interact with our website or services:

s2Items.label: Personal Information:
s2Items.text: Name, email address, phone number, and physical address when you contact us or request information.

s2Items.label: Technical Data:
s2Items.text: IP address, browser type, operating system, and website usage data collected via cookies and analytics tools to improve user experience.

s2Items.label: Business Data:
s2Items.text: Information regarding your agricultural needs, fertilizer usage, and distributor queries.

privacy.s3Intro: Your data is collected and processed for the following purposes:
s3Items: To provide, maintain, and improve our website and services.
To respond to your inquiries, customer support requests, and business proposals.
To communicate important notices regarding our products, terms, and policies.
For internal analytics, market research, and business development.
To comply with applicable legal and regulatory obligations in India.
privacy.s4Body: By accessing our website and voluntarily providing your personal data, you consent to the collection, storage, and processing of your information as described in this policy. You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time by contacting our Grievance Officer, subject to legal and contractual restrictions.
privacy.s5Intro: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share your data only under the following circumstances:

s5Items.label: Service Providers:
s5Items.text: With trusted third-party vendors who assist us in operating our website and conducting our business, strictly under confidentiality agreements.

s5Items.label: Legal Compliance:
s5Items.text: When requested by government authorities, courts, or law enforcement agencies under applicable Indian laws.

s5Items.label: Business Transfers:
s5Items.text: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of company assets.

privacy.s6Body: We implement comprehensive and reasonable security practices and procedures (as mandated by Section 43A of the IT Act, 2000) to safeguard your personal data from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. This includes secure servers, firewalls, and encrypted data transmission.
privacy.s7Intro: Under the DPDP Act and IT Rules, you have the right to:
s7Items: Request access to the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction or updating of inaccurate or incomplete data.
Request the erasure of your personal data when it is no longer necessary for the purpose collected.
File a grievance regarding data processing.

privacy.s9Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in legal requirements or our operational practices. The revised policy will be effective immediately upon posting on this website.
